subset_reference.method: exact enumeration of all C(9,3)=84 three-seed subsets of the basis
subset_reference.why: an exact reference has no sampling error of its own, which matters when the question is whether a three-seed mean is unusual

verdict.reading: a three-seed mean drawn from this basis can differ from another three-seed mean by up to the subset range shown above, which on the matched native control arm is several times the nine-seed sd of the Q arm; three seeds therefore cannot support a direction claim on that arm, and the paper reports per-seed sign counts instead
